correctness.rationale: The claim is finite and exhaustive. The complete 64-word ambient space is regenerated. Every pairwise three-symbol distance is computed by two independent definitions and the matrices agree exactly. Complete Bron--Kerbosch enumeration and an independent fixed-size clique census both obtain maximum size eight and exactly 776 maximizers, with no nine-clique. Affine closure and the entire 768-element translation-dihedral action are then checked on every maximizer.

value.rationale: The parameter is the smallest binary length in the published linear MDS family with b=3 and d_3=6, so the equality layer is canonical rather than arbitrary. The result shows substantial nonlinear abundance: 544 of 776 optima are nonlinear, and the ten-orbit decomposition gives a reusable structural benchmark for searches and classification in b-symbol coding. The sharp contrast with the nearby symbol-pair equality layer, where all maxima are affine, supplies additional mathematical motivation.
